selection.population: 131 cleaned Dunmari Frontier transcripts, sorted by path

scope: 19 illustrative interaction records from selected passages across three randomly selected transcripts; not an exhaustive NPC or mention inventory.

conventions.importance: Provisional editorial classification of this interaction, not of the NPC globally. major: consequential action or information; minor: supporting exchange; color: incidental presence.
conventions.interaction: met means direct contact/shared scene, not necessarily first meeting; fought means opponent; mention means absent subject discussed.
conventions.other_npcs_present: Supported subset only; empty list is not proof of absence unless presence_status says so. PCs excluded. Unnamed groups retained.
conventions.date: In-world DR date. Recording timestamps are separate. Dates may use session-note or recap chronology.
conventions.context: One short AI-written sentence, checked against cited transcript evidence.
conventions.visibility: Local author-review pilot only. No publication visibility rules have been extracted; not suitable for automatic public publication.
